descriptions.description: Hispidella is a genus of flowering plants in the family Asteraceae.Lamarck, Jean-Baptiste Pierre Antoine de Monet de. 1789. Encyclopédie Méthodique, Botanique 3: 134 short description in Latin, longer description and commentary in FrenchTropicos, Hispidella Barnadez ex Lam. The genus is monotypic with only one known species, Hispidella hispanica, native to the Iberian Peninsula (Portugal and Spain).
